symptoms.label: Pickup or ride service fails
symptoms.root_cause: Drivers fail to reach the agreed pickup or refuse, abandon, or make boarding unsafe, and the resulting cancellation is charged to the passenger. Verify arrival and service events before assigning fees, and address driver conduct or pickup accuracy.

symptoms.label: Unexpected charge or unresolved balance
symptoms.root_cause: Trip status, cancellation timing, payment reconciliation, refunds, or fare adjustments leave customers with disputed charges or balances. Audit trip and payment records together, then correct the charge and apply any approved credit or refund.

dropped_causes.label: Passenger cannot settle pending balance
dropped_causes.description: The passenger needs payment instructions or a supported way to pay an acknowledged outstanding charge.
